the-final-battle.text: The player enters the stone circle south of Varrock with Silverlight.

the-final-battle.speaker: Denath
the-final-battle.text: Arise, O mighty Delrith! Bring destruction to this soft, weak city!
The wizards cast an evil spell...

the-final-battle.speaker: Denath
the-final-battle.text: Ha ha ha! At last you are free, my demonic brother! Rest now, and then have your revenge on this pitiful city!

the-final-battle.speaker: Denath
the-final-battle.text: Noo! Not Silverlight! Delrith is not ready yet!

the-final-battle.speaker: Denath
the-final-battle.text: I've got to get out of here...

the-final-battle-after-lowering-delrith-.text: Delrith is weakened and no longer attacking.

the-final-battle-after-lowering-delrith-.player: Now what was that incantation again?

the-final-battle-after-lowering-delrith-.text: The following five words in the order from earlier on.
If the player incorrectly selects the five words:

steps.text: The vortex collapses. That was the wrong incantation.
Delrith heals to full Hitpoints and continues fighting

the-final-battle-after-lowering-delrith-.text: If the player correctly selects the five words:

steps.text: Delrith is sucked into the vortex...
...back into the dark dimension from which he came.
You scurry away from the enraged dark wizards having defeated the demon.
Congratulations! Quest complete!

HrjKZI.player: Well I'd better press on with it.
